quest.title: The Mysterious Island's Truth
quest.description: You finally determine the mysterious island's location, but whether or not you'll be able to finish your journey as you desire remains to be seen...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Contention x5, The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.num: Where the Springs Return: Act III
chapter.title: Journey to the Mysterious Island

talks.objective: Go to where Mualani and the others are

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Just in time, I was about to go look for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the... You already caused the whirlpools to reappear again?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We're in luck. The Phlogiston Nodes were recharged by dawn. I had Karya and Viramdra control the nodes this time, and we were able to quickly unlock the mechanism.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We were practicing all morning so they could get the hang of controlling them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? It seems that after apologizing, you've already become trusted members of the team.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Is now really the time to be teasing us? Don't forget that the whirlpools won't last all day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's right, we really should hurry over to the massive whirlpool again!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Even though we had this discussion yesterday, I still want to double check... You all trust me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You bet!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Okay, then let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *coughing* Paimon accidentally swallowed some water... So scary! Huh, what is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I can't believe it! There are subterranean caverns under the water!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mualani was right!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's see where this cave leads. Come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that lava up ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It appears these caves were formed by volcanic activity.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I see... then the Spiritways were affecting lava deep underground.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Altering the lava's flow created temporary holes which allowed us to follow the water's current and enter this underground space. Yes, it can all be explained in theory now.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Are all scholars from Sumeru like this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hard to say...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: But can there be an island in this kind of underground space?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It appears we haven't reached our destination yet. Let's keep going, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a maze... there's lava everywhere! Which way are we supposed to go now...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's look around together and see what we can find.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Very well. It would indeed be useful to collect some environmental samples here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are plants growing here?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: There's nothing unusual about that. This is Spinel Fruit, which often grows around places with lava.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Wait, it is a little strange... this isn't ordinary Spinel Fruit. It's the same as the one on this talisman.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that the talisman your teacher gave you?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yes, in which case, could Uncle Nuu have been here before? But he clearly told me that he'd never made it to the mysterious island...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I'll be sure to ask him about it once we get back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's so much lava, and it's getting pretty hot!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The lava here doesn't look very stable... I'm afraid we can't stay here for long.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: From here, the light seems to be getting brighter. Speaking of which, where is that light coming from?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: A distant light... Wait, there seems to be a mark that matches that on the map.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Miss Guide, it seems Viramdra has also discovered something...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I've got it... I've got it!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: How can I get Viramdra to stop running off?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Do you see that golden light in the distance? I'm positive that's the mysterious island! That's where we should go next!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I'm a scholar from the Akademiya's Spantamad Darshan. I specialize in ores and minerals.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: When I first heard about the legend of the mysterious island, I took note of its description.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: One exaggerated description I heard was that it's "an entire island that shines like gold." What it was actually referring to was an extremely rare mineral known as Vulcanite.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Under certain environmental conditions, large amounts of lava are quickly cooled, which then results in this ore.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Since the ore can't be moved in time, it begins to accumulate, resulting in the alluring golden glow...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, there'll be a large pool of lava up ahead, and the mysterious island will be floating on the lava! An entire island of Vulcanite ore!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you mean... we really found the mysterious island!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Rejoice! Even a small piece of that ore will be priceless!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Then let's hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Wait, Paimon. We should head back now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Why?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: What are you saying?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This map is covered with symbols and riddles, but there's one thing that's written clearly. "When you see the golden light, then go the opposite way."

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: What you just said may be correct, but that golden place isn't the island that my ancestors once visited.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Are you joking? You expect me to turn back now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Mualani's judgment has always been right... If she says head back, then we should head back. We can't be fooled by the thought of treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: You thought I'm after treasure? Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's acting weird again...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: After my previous findings were stolen, I began a new area of research... And this ore is the core of my research.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: As long as I can bring this ore back, my theories will be proven beyond any doubt, and I will be able to reclaim everything I have lost.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: To me, this ore is the "result" that must be obtained. Otherwise, all those hardships along the way will be rendered completely meaningless! Don't you understand!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: As we agreed before, please trust my judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Why? Are you wary of me? Now that we've confirmed that the legendary treasure really exists, you don't want outsiders to take it, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: She's not that kind of person, Viramdra...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: The result is right before my very eyes. I won't give up here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, he went running in! How could he do that!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Not good, we must stop him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or is the ground shaking!?

talks.objective: Defeat the monsters in your way

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: It's right there... I'm almost there!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Look carefully! You can't get through the lava. You'll die if you try to make your way forward. Why don't you just give up?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Why don't I give up? Well, I might not be able to do it, but what about you?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: You have the ability to move over the lava. If you try, maybe you can reach the island, and earn the highest honor for a guide!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: That way, you'll have the results you need to prove yourself, and even Koolau won't be able to question your abilities anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: You want to know why I don't give up, but I'm asking why you'd give up such an opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The lava is rising! If I take this risk, then how will the others get back? Did you forget? I already gave you my answer.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: You...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Come with me!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Mualani uses her surprising strength to toss the reluctant Viramdra onto her surfboard.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The lava is rising...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Viramdra...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}, Paimon, please take care of Karya. I'll be right back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you doing, Mualani?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I can use my surfboard on the lava for a short period of time... But it will be a lot spicier than surfing on water...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that's way too risky!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Okay, then we'll take care of things here!

choices.text: I know she can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: I've got it... I've got it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I've brought him back. He's fortunate that he wasn't seriously hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Thank goodness... Thank you so much, Miss Guide!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You're welcome. It's getting dangerous here, so we need to find a way out!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: No, I refuse! I can still stand, let me go back...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously! How can you be so childish at a time like this!?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Viramdra!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whoa...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: I've always believed that you're the most talented person I've ever met. Even if your research was stolen and you didn't get any credit, I never doubted it!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: I believe that even if you won't obtain any results this time, you'll still succeed in your new research, because no one can take your talent away!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: So... I won't allow my dearest senior to die here because of his own stubbornness!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Karya...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: She's finally opening up, and it seems like she's just the person we need to talk some sense into him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mualani, the lava is almost here!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Don't panic! It seems like the trick that Uncle Nuu taught me is finally going to be put to use.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: *whistle*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where did all these Koholasaurs come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: No time to explain, just get on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it, got it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *coughing* Ah, Paimon accidentally choked on some water again while riding the Koholasaur...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Everyone okay? Let's take a headcount... One, two, three, four, five... Whew, we're all here.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We escaped danger and made it back alive. That's what I call good luck. I think our fortune can only get better from now on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Really?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: What's the point? We still didn't reach the mysterious island...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, don't look so depressed! You'll scare our good luck away!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Actually, according to the map, we still have one more leg of the journey...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Then which way should we go? Wait... Aren't we back where we started?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Come on, let's go to the statue.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone arrives at the statue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what's the point of coming back here again?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Here, look! Some hidden words appeared on the statue after I touched it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? Let Paimon try!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ##2D Package Video begins

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ##2D Package Video ends

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The hidden inscriptions disappeared...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: These must have been the words the first chief left for those that would come after him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, the mysterious island from the legend is actually where the People of the Springs are living now!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I remember now that the elders once told me our tribe was originally founded on a small island. Later, the coastlines changed, allowing the island to become what it is today.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The journey to the mysterious island starts exactly where it ends...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Yeah, I think I understand the choice he made now.

response.speaker: Viramdra
response.text: The golden glow is an indicator of when the lava will periodically erupt... Hmm, if that's the case...

response.speaker: Viramdra
response.text: The principle of Vulcanite formation implies that it will only appear at the start of fierce lava activity... and the flowing lava will quickly swallow it and make it all disappear without a trace.

response.speaker: Viramdra
response.text: This means that there's zero possibility of ever bringing the ore back. Are the results I've been chasing all this time... only an illusion that can be seen from far away?

response.speaker: Karya
response.text: Viramdra...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Our journey is not yet over. As we agreed, please come back to the People of the Springs with me. Then we'll officially complete this journey.

response.speaker: Viramdra
response.text: Fine, I suppose that would also count as some kind of result.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Don't be so down. I have a feeling that the next answer I'm looking for will also be useful to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon remembers now! There's still something important we need to ask Mualani's teacher about!

talks.objective: Accompany Mualani to return the talisman

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Uncle Nuu, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Ah, Mualani... It's good to see you again. I always knew you'd return safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Uncle, I've completed the journey to the mysterious island. I'm here to return the talisman.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: ...But you still have a question you wish to ask me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yes. You've been there before, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Yes, I have.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: If that's the case, then you've gone on the same journey. But why didn't you tell anyone?

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Because... I made a choice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A choice?

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Did you notice that the hidden inscriptions on the stone tablet disappeared as soon as you finished reading them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, you're right...

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: There's a special paint on the statue that would change color when it comes into contact with volcanic dust.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Only those who have been to that underground space will be contaminated by the dust, and be able to see the hidden message. But once the dust starts to wear off, the hidden inscription will disappear again.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: And this is the choice that the first chief left to us.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: If you choose to boast about your deeds, you will receive the highest honor, but the legend of the mysterious island would be destroyed as well.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: If you choose to remain silent, then the mysterious island will remain a legend, and continue to attract the next generation of young guides to rise to the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: In the end, my companions and I all chose the latter.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ahh... I get it now...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: But not being able to tell anyone after accomplishing such a feat... People like Koolau will still look down on you. Are you really okay with that?

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: But have you noticed that Koolau, who claims to have been to the island, hasn't actually completed the trip?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, Paimon remembers that Koolau said that he went to the mysterious island alone, but there's no way he could've been able to use the Spiritways!

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: He deliberately recommended the client to find Mualani, probably because he thought she wouldn't be able to reach the mysterious island. That way, Mualani wouldn't be able to expose him.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: As guides, we are not adventurers, let alone treasure hunters. The greatest responsibility of a guide is to take the client to their destination safely.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: But in the process, we also gain much skill and experience at overcoming danger. This allows us to go to places that no one else can reach, and even find treasures that no one else can find.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Many guides gradually lose sight of their true beliefs and intentions in the process, and end up becoming like Koolau.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: They end up becoming more like thieves who would rush to the other side of the lava lake regardless of the consequences, rather than good guides who would turn around and save their friends.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: This is why the first chief left behind the legend and the map... to lure younger generations into taking up the challenge, thereby teaching them everything he had learned.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Aside from me, many other tribe members have also traveled to the mysterious island. And just like me, they understood the first chief's intentions.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: So they've also made pacts with their companions, choosing to give up the results that would prove themselves, and give the younger generation the chance to continue the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: You've all given up on the results...

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Sir, I've given up on merely one result. I haven't given up on everything.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Given her talent and qualifications, Mualani was well within her rights to choose the top-ranked guide Koolau as her teacher, but she chose me.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: I believe I was able to cultivate such an outstanding student and witness her completion of the legendary challenge precisely because I didn't become someone like Koolau.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: If instead of looking at one single journey, we look at my entire career as a guide, I'd say I have not returned empty-handed. What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Karya... I've come up with a new research topic. Would you like to continue working as my assistant?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: You're the same as always, Viramdra. You always have to find evidence before coming to a conclusion.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: In any case, I can't give you an answer right now.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Karya?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Because you haven't prepared the proposal yet. Shouldn't you finish that first before recruiting assistants? How could you forget?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Ah yes, of course. I'll certainly prepare all the necessary details...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: But, I've always found your proposals fascinating, so I'm sure I won't be able to turn you down this time, either.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Karya... Given I have been presented with new evidence, I have come up with a very general theory... I can use the ideas from the chief's speech to express it.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Perhaps the treasure I'm seeking has been by my side the entire time... No, to be more precise, it's been with me even before I set out on this journey.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: I understand, Viramdra.

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: It appears this guest has also found his answer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems he's finally put two and two together.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: There's nothing to worry about. It's just like Karya said — I can start some new research and reclaim everything I've lost.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it seems he's still as stubborn as before!

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Now it's your turn to make the choice, Mualani.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But Uncle Nuu, I'm sure anyone who can complete the journey to the island would make the same choice, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Very good. Then there's nothing more I can teach you. Here, take this talisman again. You can pass it on to your student in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Looks like it's also our time to say goodbye. You've taken great care of us throughout our journey. As thanks, I'm also willing to keep the journey a secret.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Then remember, the next time you come to visit the People of the Springs, you know where to find friends for help.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Friends? I supposed we are theoretically friends now, yes. When I publish my next paper, I'll be sure to add you to my list of acknowledgements.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's one way to thank someone...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Then Viramdra and I will be taking our leave. I truly hope we'll get to see you all again someday!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, bye-bye!

dialogues.speaker: Koolau
dialogues.text: You're back already? So, as Nuu's student, did you manage to find the mysterious island?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you doing here all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Well... I found something even more precious than the island... two friends that I can trust with my life!

response.speaker: Koolau
response.text: You... hmph! Seems you've really learned a lot from Nuu about how to make yourself feel better. I knew it... how could anyone ever reach the island with so many hindrances?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Mm-hmm!

response.speaker: Nuu
response.text: Haha...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hee-hee!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hehe!

response.speaker: Koolau
response.text: Huh, wh—why are you all looking at me like that? The elders in the tribe also gave me that same look. What's that supposed to mean?

response.speaker: Koolau
response.text: Nuu, I've already proven that I'm stronger than you. I've been to even more dangerous places, and found far more precious treasures.

response.speaker: Koolau
response.text: I've even been to... the mysterious island! Why do you still look at me as if my words don't bother you at all?

response.speaker: Nuu
response.text: Koolau, even if you had never been to the island, no one would deny your abilities.

response.speaker: Nuu
response.text: But as for what we would deny about you... only you can find the answer to that.

response.speaker: Koolau
response.text: Me? Hmph!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So now our trip to the mysterious island is officially finished, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's time to say goodbye.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Yeah, but I have one more place I want to show you. Come with me!

choices.text: He wants to know if she made it.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This is the place. From what I've heard, if we take a group photo here, it'll bring us good luck. I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What made you think of taking a group photo?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well, we completed our trip to the mysterious island together, so of course we need a memento to keep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* You've earned the greatest honor for a guide, yet you can only walk away with a photo of your friends. You're pretty amazing, Mualani. You really sacrificed a lot for your tribe!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Would you call it a sacrifice? I don't really think so. Actually, after hearing Uncle Nuu's answer, I have this vague feeling that...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: After all that we've been through together, the results don't matter anymore... Ah, it's kinda hard to explain, I don't know if you get me or not...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, I get it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (You recall everything that has happened during your journey, and finally find an answer that you're satisfied with.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So that's your answer, huh? To the meaning of a journey?

choices.text: It's the answer I knew from the very beginning.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It's a good one... Then let's make this group photo yet another part of your journey!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! Paimon's ready!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Three... two... one... Koholasaur!

choices.text: It's the answer that I've gradually come to understand over time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, what's that light?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's keep going. We'll be able to see more clearly up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Watch your step. Follow closely, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Mualani. We'll take care of things here!

dialogues.speaker: Nuu
dialogues.text: Mualani... she has quite a sense of ceremony. I'm sure she'll want to give you something as a memento. I suggest to not keep her waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I wonder when the next journey will begin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon slept so well... Mualani and the others seem to be up already. Let's go see what they're up to!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Over there! Phew, looks like I'm just in time...
